surfaces.label: Contingency-table tests, measures, diagnostics, and chart data
surfaces.boundary: Thirty-nine registered numerical tools are available through the local MCP server.

surfaces.label: Versioned methods, limitations, and public evidence links
surfaces.boundary: Two MCP resources are available and are required by the plugin workflow for material interpretations.

surfaces.label: Local CSV, TSV, XLSX, SAV, and inline-record import
surfaces.boundary: The headless server imports supported respondent files locally into versioned project waves. Work remains bounded by the published multidimensional workload envelope.

surfaces.label: Assumption-aware, evidence-linked survey analysis guidance
surfaces.boundary: The Codex skill requires bases, assumptions, effect sizes, multiplicity status, limitations, and non-causal wording.

surfaces.label: Saved filters, row sets, weights, multibanners, ordering, and export recipes
surfaces.boundary: The local crosstabs-headless server shares the workspace project service and persists filters, row sets, weights, multibanners, table order, waves, and export recipes.

surfaces.label: Significance letters, open-end coding, and theme approval
surfaces.boundary: The local headless server runs tables and tab books with significance letters and supports evidence-linked open-end proposals, review, approval, materialized variables, and guarded undo.

surfaces.label: Editable PPTX/DOCX generation, refresh, and manual-edit preservation
surfaces.boundary: The local headless server generates editable PPTX/DOCX packs and refreshes compatible generated regions while preserving declared manual edits.

surfaces.label: Replace/refresh, schema-drift detection and repair, and wave comparison
surfaces.boundary: The local headless server imports immutable replacement waves, previews and applies approved reversible schema repair plans, and compares compatible tables across waves.

surfaces.label: Shared cloud review, comments, and optional connector authorization
surfaces.boundary: These networked collaboration surfaces remain separate from the local Codex plugin.

surfaces.label: Vercel AI Gateway open-end coding
surfaces.boundary: Only code_open_ends can invoke Vercel AI Gateway, only after explicit external-processing approval. Deterministic calculations, local projects, and exports do not use an LLM or application analytics.
